premises.text: Most Americans sleep with someone else and partners' sleep habits cause widespread sleep disruption and relationship tension
premises.evidence_span: Over 75% of Americans sleep with someone else in the room. And we're ruining each other's sleep day in and day out. In fact, a national sleep survey found that 38% of couples experience high relationship tension because of their partner's sleeping habits

premises.text: LarkUp is a silent, natural-feeling wake-up using a Lark wristband plus smartphone app and nightstand dock
premises.evidence_span: LarkUp is a silent and completely natural-feeling wake-up. And all you need is our Lark wristband and your smartphone

premises.text: Wristband has no buttons, clasps, or screens so it can be worn and forgotten while the phone handles interaction
premises.evidence_span: no buttons, no clasps, no screens, just something you put on and forget about

premises.text: Patented wake technology developed with a Harvard sleep expert is claimed 100% effective across sleep phases and about 2.5 times more peaceful than a regular alarm
premises.evidence_span: It's 100% effective in waking you in all phases of sleep

premises.text: Unlike adrenaline-jolting alarm clocks, Lark Up creates a peaceful natural-feeling wake-up by circumventing stress-hormone crash
premises.evidence_span: an alarm clock jolts you up with adrenaline. Because of that, you get stress hormones, you get heightened blood pressure, heightened heart rate, and that crashes you almost immediately. By circumventing this, Lark Up creates a peaceful and natural-feeling wake-up

value.text: Help couples sleep better together by waking one partner silently so the other can sleep in
value.evidence_span: we help couples sleep better together

secondary_value.text: Partner gets to sleep in undisturbed
secondary_value.evidence_span: best of all, she gets to sleep in
